text:
Amanda Li: Quick update: Regional Streaming Connectors are GA as of 08:00 PT. These connectors add region-aware streaming + tool-calling optimizations (ap-east & eu-central first). Rolling rollout details below — pls read if you touch SDKs, tools, or oncall.

Miguel Torres: Nice! Do existing streaming apps need code changes?

Amanda Li: Most won't. We added an opt-in header X-Connector-Region and a new streaming endpoint prefix /v2/connector/stream. Default streaming remains backward compatible and will continue to work.

Amanda Li: Example (ws):
```
wscat -c "wss://api.redwood.ai/v2/connector/stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Connector-Region: eu-central"
{
  "type": "start",
  "model": "mosaic-tool-x",
  "input": "Fetch latest sales summary"
}
```

OpsBot: rollout: canary eu-central 4% -> 25% (1992003600) :rocket:

Jamie Park: Any pricing changes or surcharges?

Amanda Li: There is a small regional premium to offset pre-warm and tool-exec costs. We documented scenarios where net bill might drop due to reduced cross-region egress. Internal PRICING doc linked in thread.

DevEx Bot: SDK notes: redwood-js@0.9.7 adds ConnectorClient with streaming helper and automatic reconnection. redwood-py@0.9.7 has connector.AsyncClient. Examples in repo.

Nina Shah: SLA and paging impact?

Amanda Li: SLA unchanged. New alerts: connector-high-latency and connector-tool-failures. We also added a fast-failover path: if connector health degrades, traffic is routed to global streaming endpoints. See runbook.

Miguel Torres: Rollback plan?

Amanda Li: Rollback triggers: sustained error rate >3% over 10m, tool-exec failure surge, or VIP customer impact. Rollback steps: disable connector routing flag -> global fallback. Ops owns the kill-switch; contact @Miguel Torres or @Jamie Park.

DeployBot: schedule: ap-east, eu-central, us-east over 48h (1992003680).

Amanda Li: Security: connectors honor KMS encryption and preserve audit logs. Regulated tenants remain opt-in. Security sign-off docs in internal drive.

Jamie Park: Observability dashboards?

Amanda Li: Console -> Observability -> Connectors shows per-region tool-latency, stream p50/p95, connection churn, and tool success rates. Alerts wired to #eng-oncall.

Nina Shah: Customer comms? Auto-migrate?

Amanda Li: Self-serve accounts auto-opted-in with an opt-out path. Enterprise CSMs will be contacted with a scheduled test window. Draft comms linked.

Miguel Torres: Quick ask for SDK owners: please smoke-test connector flows by EOD tomorrow.

Amanda Li: Thanks — links: docs: https://redwood.internal/docs/connectors, runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/connectors, pricing: https://redwood.internal/pricing/connectors. Ping me for staging creds. :thumbsup:
